headline: Quarterly growth was mixed, with a few firms posting strong top‑line gains while others saw modest or slowing revenue.
summary: Coforge led the pack with over 50% revenue growth, driven by AI‑focused services. HCLTech and TCS delivered solid double‑digit growth and healthy margins. Infosys trimmed its FY27 guidance as revenue growth stalled at 1.5%. Profitability improved for most, but Wipro and Infosys posted weaker earnings.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI contributions, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech’s AI revenue reaching $219 m.

themes.title: Margin pressure on mid‑tier players
themes.detail: Despite high growth, companies like LTM and Tech Mahindra posted operating margins below 16%, indicating cost challenges.

themes.title: Headcount and attrition trends
themes.detail: HCLTech added 6,450 staff but faced 12.8% attrition; Wipro’s headcount fell by 6,716 with 13.8% attrition, reflecting talent market volatility.

leaders.why: Revenue surged 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.
Consistent double‑digit revenue growth (11.2% YoY) and strong operating margin of 24%.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut to 1‑2%.
Revenue grew only 9.1% YoY while net profit fell 1.9% and headcount declined.
